problem.p: Vector field $$\mathbf{\text{F}}(x,y) = x^{2}y\mathbf{\text{i}} + y^{2}x\mathbf{\text{j}}$$ is conservative.
For vector field $$\mathbf{\text{F}}(x,y) = P(x,y)\mathbf{\text{i}} + Q(x,y)\mathbf{\text{j}},$$ if $$P_{y}(x,y) = Q_{x}(x,y)$$ in open region $$D,$$ then $${\int_{C}{Pdx + Qdy = 0}}.$$
The divergence of a vector field is a vector field.
If $$\text{curl}\ \mathbf{\text{F}} = 0,$$ then $$\mathbf{\text{F}}$$ is a conservative vector field.
$$\mathbf{\text{F}}\left( {x,y} \right) = \frac{1}{2}\mathbf{\text{i}} + 2x\mathbf{\text{j}}$$
$$\textbf{F}(x,y) = \frac{\mathbf{\left. <{\mathit{y},3\mathit{x}}> \right.}}{\sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2}}}$$
$$\mathbf{\text{F}}\left( {x,y} \right) = y\mathbf{\text{i}} + \left( {x - 2e^{y}} \right)\mathbf{\text{j}}$$
$$\mathbf{\text{F}}\left( {x,y} \right) = \left( {6xy} \right)\mathbf{\text{i}} + \left( {3x^{2} - ye^{y}} \right)\mathbf{\text{j}}$$
$$\mathbf{\text{F}}\left( {x,y,z} \right) = \left( {2xy + z^{2}} \right)\mathbf{\text{i}} + \left( {x^{2} + 2yz} \right)\mathbf{\text{j}} + \left( {2xz + y^{2}} \right)\mathbf{\text{k}}$$
$$\mathbf{\text{F}}(x,y,z) = \left( {e^{x}y} \right)\mathbf{\text{i}} + \left( {e^{x} + z} \right)\mathbf{\text{j}} + \left( {e^{x} + y^{2}} \right)\mathbf{\text{k}}$$
$$\int\limits_{C}{x^{2}dy + \left( {2x - 3xy} \right)dx,}$$ along $$C:y = \frac{1}{2}x$$ from (0, 0) to (4, 2)
$$\int\limits_{C}{ydx + xy^{2}dy,}$$ where $$C:x = \sqrt{t},y = t - 1,0 \leq t \leq 1$$
$$\left. \iint{}_{S}{xy^{2}dS} \right.,$$ where S is surface $$z = x^{2} - y,0 \leq x \leq 1,0 \leq y \leq 4$$
$$\mathbf{\text{F}}(x,y,z) = 3xyz\mathbf{\text{i}} + xye^{z}\mathbf{\text{j}} - 3xy\mathbf{\text{k}}$$
$$\mathbf{\text{F}}(x,y,z) = e^{x}\mathbf{\text{i}} + e^{xy}\mathbf{\text{j}} + e^{xyz}\mathbf{\text{k}}$$

solution.p: Divergence: $$e^{x} + xe^{xy} + xye^{xyz},$$ curl: $$xze^{xyz}\mathbf{\text{i}} - yze^{xyz}\mathbf{\text{j}} + ye^{xy}\mathbf{\text{k}}$$
